title: Reading Drill — Maintaining cobbled streets — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Maintaining cobbled streets — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The street repair supervisor had been asked to investigate loose stones moving under delivery trolleys in Brackenton. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on the number of displaced stones, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a seven-week comparison, the team used site inspections at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because the weight of deliveries might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward different packing around repaired stones. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
